description:
At 43 metres, Behike is one of the most impressive superyachts available for charter in Dubai. Her golden hull, expansive decks and classic interior make her a natural choice for an unforgettable event or a private day at sea.

On board, the wood-panelled saloon and the sky lounge, complete with a grand piano, offer elegant spaces to gather. Outside, several lounge decks and a jacuzzi overlook the sea and the Dubai skyline.

She has five cabins and is run by a crew of 6, with capacity for up to 50 guests.

Contact Yacht Research for availability, routes and a tailored quote.
